$doc: SOGH contact config — single source of truth for confirmed public contact details across the app, sales kit, and all print/social exports. Synced from the v1.1 fork on 2026-07-16 per owner decision. RULES: empty values are unconfirmed and MUST stay hidden from every interface and export (no placeholders in client-facing output). The domain is NOT registered yet — never present any domain as official until confirmed. The phone number is telephone-only; WhatsApp is not confirmed. After any change, regenerate exports: npm run dev (keep running) + npm run exports:svg + npm run exports:png, then node scripts/verify-exports.mjs.
